name: ZS Soybean Carry Curve Dashboard
description: ZS soybean carry curve analysis: current carry level (front/back - 1), 60-day trend with 20d MA, historical March seasonal context via avg carry by calendar month, and event markers for every carry zero-crossing (contango↔backwardation flip). Uses NoAdjustment + spread_depth=1 via reference_futures piped through futures_continuation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZS SOYBEAN CARRY CURVE DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
# Answers: Is ZS carry flipping toward backwardation or still in contango?
#
# Three analytical questions:
#   1. CONTEXT: Where is carry right now and what's the 60-day trend?
#   2. SEASONAL: Is March structurally contango or backwardation historically?
#   3. FLIP SIGNAL: When did carry last cross zero? Is a flip imminent?
#
# Data: reference_futures('ZS') → futures_continuation(NoAdjustment, spread_depth=1)
#   cont.carry = M1/M2 - 1  (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)
#   cont.spread = M1 - M2 price difference
#
# NoAdjustment: preserves real price levels for carry computation.
# spread_depth=1: enables cont.carry and cont.spread outputs.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZS via reference_futures → futures_continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

zs_close = cont.c
zs_carry = cont.carry
zs_spread = cont.spread

# --- Trend: 20-day MA of carry ---
carry_ma20 = ma(period=20)(zs_carry)

# --- Calendar month for seasonal analysis ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Seasonal: expanding mean carry per calendar month ---
# Using expanding (cumulative) mean so it's period-agnostic and improves with more data
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, zs_carry)))
feb_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, zs_carry)))
mar_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, zs_carry)))
apr_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, zs_carry)))
may_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, zs_carry)))
jun_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, zs_carry)))
jul_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, zs_carry)))
aug_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, zs_carry)))
sep_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, zs_carry)))
oct_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, zs_carry)))
nov_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, zs_carry)))
dec_carry_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, zs_carry)))

# --- Carry zero-crossing detection (contango ↔ backwardation flip) ---
# crossover: carry crosses ABOVE zero → flipping to backwardation
# crossunder: carry crosses BELOW zero → flipping to contango
is_flip_to_backwardation = crossover(zs_carry, 0)
is_flip_to_contango = crossunder(zs_carry, 0)
is_any_flip = is_flip_to_backwardation or is_flip_to_contango

# Regime label for event marker: 1 = backwardation flip, 0 = contango flip
# Use carry level at the flip bar as the Hero metric
flip_carry_level = where(is_any_flip, zs_carry)
flip_price = where(is_any_flip, zs_close)
flip_ma20 = where(is_any_flip, carry_ma20)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Snapshot (FIRST, reference exhibit)
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZS Carry Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Carry', 'Spread & Price'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Period High', 'Period Low'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current carry (M1/M2 - 1)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period high carry', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(info='Period low carry', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current M1-M2 spread (cents/bu)', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='20d MA of carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current front-month close', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='ZS Carry Curve',
    order=1
)(zs_carry, zs_carry, zs_carry, zs_spread, carry_ma20, zs_close)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Carry Time Series — 60-day trend with 20d MA
# Context: where is carry now and which direction is it trending?
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZS Carry: Is It Flipping Toward Backwardation?',
    category='ZS Carry Curve',
    y_axis_label='Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=5,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero (Flip Line)')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZS Carry', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(zs_carry, carry_ma20))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Seasonal Bar — Avg carry by calendar month
# Punchline: is March structurally contango or backwardation?
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Is March Structurally Contango? Avg ZS Carry by Month',
    category='ZS Carry Curve',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Calendar Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=5,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=zs_carry, label=month_num)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Event Markers — Carry zero-crossings (contango ↔ backwardation flips)
# Each clickable event shows carry level, spread, and price at the flip
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='ZS Carry Flip',
        icon=Icon.ActivityIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry at Flip', dp=5, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='M1-M2 Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d MA', dp=5, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='ZS Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(flip_carry_level, zs_spread, flip_ma20, flip_price, is_any_flip)
